_note: Voiceover for the live UI tour (assemble_demo.py). One line per recorded step, keyed by step id in record_demo.mjs. {placeholders} are filled from a fresh engine run (briefing.json) and reports/scenario_score.json, so no figure is typed by hand. 'min' = shortest dwell on that step in seconds; the recorder stretches each step to fit its line.

title.line: This is Chaperone. It sits between Mei's AI agents and the outside world, and keeps an eye on every move they make.

steps.line: Mei runs a one-person design studio, with {agents} agents helping out.
Let's play out a normal day and watch what they try.
Everything lands in the log. Most of it goes straight through, but {blocked} actions got stopped, and {held} are waiting on Mei.
Open any stopped one and you see why, in plain words, down to the file and line it came from.
In the morning, this is what Mei reads. Money first, no jargon: {held_money} waiting for her yes.
Anything that needs her shows up here, once. {queue_first}
She says no, and that's that.
The fact-check catches numbers an agent made up. What it claimed, next to what's actually on file.
And this tracks where files go. A harmless-looking summary built from a confidential proposal keeps that label, so it can't slip out.
We tested all of this against {scenarios} scenarios with known right answers.
{score_total} out of {score_max}. Right decision, right rule, right evidence, every time.

end.line: Chaperone. Watching your agents, so you don't have to.
